description: Next.js Frontend with military/tactical dark theme UI - authentication pages, dashboard layout, infrastructure graph visualization, asset inventory, attack path visualization, and real-time status indicators. Uses Next.js 14 App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
steps: Create /frontend/package.json with Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and related dependencies
Create /frontend/tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript configuration and path aliases
Create /frontend/next.config.js with Next.js configuration

Create /frontend/tailwind.config.ts with military/tactical theme - custom colors (cyber-cyan, tactical-green, threat-red, warning-amber, dark backgrounds), custom fonts (monospace for data), custom animations (pulse, glow, scan-line)
Create /frontend/postcss.config.js for Tailwind
Create /frontend/src/app/layout.tsx with root layout - dark theme HTML, custom fonts, global providers
Create /frontend/src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and custom military-style CSS (grid backgrounds, glow effects, scan-line animations, HUD-style borders)
Create /frontend/src/app/page.tsx redirecting to /dashboard
Create /frontend/src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx with military-styled login form - username/password fields, MFA code input, glowing submit button, tactical grid background, ARES-X branding
Create /frontend/src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx with centered auth layout with branding
Create /frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx with main dashboard layout - collapsible sidebar navigation, top header with status indicators and user menu, main content area

Create /frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx with main dashboard - stat cards (total assets, active threats, attack paths, system health), recent alerts list, system status grid, threat level indicator
Create /frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/graph/page.tsx with infrastructure graph visualization page - SVG-based graph renderer, node/edge display, zoom/pan controls, node selection panel
Create /frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/assets/page.tsx with asset inventory table - sortable columns, filtering, search, pagination, criticality badges, status indicators
Create /frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/attack-paths/page.tsx with attack path visualization - path list with risk scores, selected path detail view, step-by-step visualization
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx with tactical-styled button variants (primary/secondary/danger/ghost) with glow effects
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/Card.tsx with dark card component with border glow and header
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx with status badge component (critical/high/medium/low/info) with pulse animation for active threats
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/Table.tsx with data table component - sortable headers, row hover effects, pagination
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/Input.tsx with styled form input with focus glow effect
Create /frontend/src/components/ui/StatusIndicator.tsx with real-time status dot with pulse animation (online/offline/degraded/unknown)
Create /frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx with navigation sidebar - icon + label nav items, collapsible, active state indicator, ARES-X logo at top
Create /frontend/src/components/layout/Header.tsx with top header - breadcrumbs, global search, notifications, user avatar menu, system status summary

Create /frontend/src/components/graph/GraphCanvas.tsx with SVG-based graph visualization - renders nodes as tactical icons, edges as lines with arrows, supports zoom/pan via viewBox manipulation, node click selection
Create /frontend/src/components/graph/GraphNode.tsx with individual graph node component - icon based on type, label, criticality color ring, selection highlight
Create /frontend/src/components/graph/GraphEdge.tsx with edge component - line with directional arrow, type-based styling, hover label

Create /frontend/src/components/attack-path/PathVisualization.tsx with attack path visualization - shows path as connected steps with MITRE technique labels, risk score gradient, animated flow direction
Create /frontend/src/components/attack-path/PathStep.tsx with individual path step component - technique icon, description, probability
Create /frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCard.tsx with dashboard stat card - large number, label, trend indicator, icon, subtle glow
Create /frontend/src/components/dashboard/AlertList.tsx with recent alerts list - severity icon, message, timestamp, actionable
Create /frontend/src/components/dashboard/ThreatLevel.tsx with overall threat level gauge - visual meter with color gradient, current level label
Create /frontend/src/lib/api.ts with API client - typed fetch wrapper, auth header injection, error handling, base URL config
Create /frontend/src/lib/auth.ts with auth utilities - token storage, login/logout functions, MFA verification, session check
Create /frontend/src/lib/types.ts re-exporting types from shared/types or defining frontend-specific types
Create /frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts with authentication hook - current user, login state, permissions check
Create /frontend/src/hooks/useGraph.ts with graph data hook - fetch nodes/edges, layout computation, selection state
Create /frontend/src/hooks/useAssets.ts with assets hook - fetch, filter, paginate, search
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript/TSX files have valid syntax
Tailwind configuration includes complete military/tactical theme
Login page has proper form with MFA support
Dashboard shows stat cards, alerts, and system status
Graph visualization renders nodes and edges via SVG
Asset inventory has sortable, filterable table
Attack path visualization shows step-by-step paths
All components use tactical/military styling (dark theme, cyan/green accents, glow effects)
Proper Next.js 14 App Router file structure with layouts and pages
verification: Verify all TSX/TS files exist and have valid TypeScript syntax
Check that tailwind.config.ts has custom military theme colors and animations
Verify Next.js app router structure is correct (layout.tsx in each route group)
findings: All 37 files created and verified via TypeScript parser (no syntax errors). Node.js v22.22.3 and TypeScript 6.0.3 available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin. Need to unset NODE_OPTIONS to use node. Cannot install dependencies due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode, but all files are syntactically valid TypeScript/TSX. Next.js App Router structure with route groups (auth) and (dashboard) implemented correctly.
